detail.longDescription: The Register: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server. “Suspected Chinese spies deployed AI agents which worked autonomously to find a zero-day in an open source application and then abuse the flaw to break into university networks, gaining full control of a server, according to Amazon CISO CJ Moses.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/11/21/the-register-china-attackers-deployed-ai-agents-that-autonomously-found-and-exploited-a-0-day-to-take-over-a-university-server/
